Class BedrockDeathScreenUpdates

java.lang.Object
com.viaversion.viafabricplus.bedrock.screen.death.BedrockDeathScreenUpdates
public final class BedrockDeathScreenUpdates extends Object
One connection's death reason updates do not re-enter its screen or undo a pending respawn.
